decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension shall match those used on the existing property.

Condition : 3 - Full details of the front garden parking area to scale 1:20 with the position of the vehicular access marked, showing it to be no wider than 3.6 metres, shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. The parking area and access details as may subsequently be approved shall be provided as approved on the first bringing into use of the extension and shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 4 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority",
description: Erection of two storey side extension to house
